title: Native SerializableRun v20 with combat parity state
description: One evolving comparison-only representation for single-player awaiting_input and run_complete boundaries. Native payload stays unchanged. Known suspended-operation coverage gaps are documented in ../run-parity-spec.md; this is not a restorable save or agent observation interface.

native_model_state.description: Additional model-specific combat fields for objects already represented in native run data, keyed by JSON Pointer to that object. Omit entries without additional fields.

NativeRunFields.$comment: Open projection of native root fields only. Nested native objects retain native closure. Root closure is enforced by unevaluatedProperties in this extension.

Ref.description: Document-local JSON Pointer to a captured object. Preserve aliasing; normalize labels bijectively between exports, never compare engine memory or network IDs.

Decimal.description: Exact C# decimal value. Parse/compare losslessly, never through binary floating point.

DynamicVars.description: Mutable DynamicVar.BaseValue inputs only; omit reconstructible values and preview caches.

deck_version.description: Reference to the owner's permanent deck entry, or its detached original retained in combat.cards when no longer in the deck.

ModelFields.description: Only applicable additional gameplay fields for the containing model; include every applicable field even when zero/null. Keys use audited class/member names. Native SavedProperties stay in native serialization. No arbitrary runtime blobs.

AttackCommand.description: Stored gameplay command data only. Captured execution-loop locals and callback-specific values remain an explicit coverage gap.

CardSelectionChoice.description: An unresolved card selection using CardSelectorPrefs. Null for ordinary free play. Other choice families require explicit future definitions; do not silently coerce them to card selection.
